item.name: Service 8 - Notification and Alert Management
item.description: Manual Service 8 requests. Run Service 1 on baseURL and Service 8 on notificationURL. Create users through Service 1. Enter local username/password variables, run the login requests, and copy the returned tokens into adminToken, employeeToken, analystToken and auditorToken. Set recipientId, emptyUserId and notificationId manually from actual responses. Implemented by: Youssef Al Hajj Youness.
